title: Effective-metric formulation of Casimir energies in nonlinear scalar and electromagnetic theories
summary: We study the Casimir effect in nonlinear field theories through the effective geometries that \mbox{govern} their linearized fluctuations. Previous analyses of Lorentz-violating scalar fields showed that a constant kinetic background modifies the parallel-plate Casimir energy by a rescaling of the plate separation and an overall determinant factor. We show that this structure is not merely a consequence of diagonalizing the reduced Green function.
